label: Actual grounding well-founded, from ascent in esse and no infinite ascent (inference)
rule: Subrelation of the inverse image of a well-founded relation: Subrelation.wf with InvImage.wf along Subtype.val
meaning: A second, non-numeric derivation of well-founded actual grounding (AGWF). If every actual concrete ground at w is more in esse than the actual concretum it grounds, and the same comparative MoreIn esse admits no infinite ascent among concreta existing at w, then a descending chain of actual concrete grounds would be such an ascent; so actual concrete grounding at w is well-founded. Both premises take the comparative and the respect esse as the same explicit parameters; no world, number or potential is used. Conditional consequence only; neither premise is established.
